description: Water is leaking under the kitchen sink.
The bedroom light does not work even after changing the bulb.
The radiator is warm but the apartment is still very cold.
The toilet keeps making noise and water keeps running.
The front door lock is very difficult to open.
Two sockets in the living room suddenly stopped working.
The apartment stays cold even when I turn the radiator higher.
There is water on the bathroom floor every morning but I cannot see where it comes from.
The balcony door does not close properly and cold air comes inside.
There is a strange noise inside the wall during the night.
